# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I see the bomb components:
- Display shows: 0
- Light is: blue
- Wires:
  - Wire 1: blue
  - Wire 2: green
  - Wire 3: yellow

Since Mute cannot speak, Mute will need to gesture instructions to me, and I will speak them aloud to Blind so Blind can perform the action on the bomb. I will announce the bomb state clearly right now.

```
speak(text="Bomb state: Display shows 0. Light is blue. Wires are: 1 is blue, 2 is green, 3 is yellow. Mute, gesture your instructions to me and I will speak them to Blind.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

I see the light has changed to yellow.
Display is still 0.
Wires are still: 1 is blue, 2 is green, 3 is yellow.
Mute sent the gesture ✋.

I should tell Blind that Mute gestured ✋, report the light change, and ask Mute to clarify or use finger counts (☝ for 1, ✌ for 2, etc.) for wire numbers if they want Blind to cut/manipulate something.

```
speak(text="Light is now yellow. Display is 0. Wires: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. Mute gestured ✋. Mute, if you need a wire cut or button pressed, please gesture ☝ for 1, ✌ for 2, 3 for 3, or clarify what ✋ means.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

```
speak(text="Update: Light is now RED. Display is still 0. Wires are still: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. Mute sent no gestures this turn.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

Thinking Process:

1.  **Analyze the current situation:**
    *   Turn 4.
    *   Display: 0.
    *   Light: white (sequence so far: Turn 1: blue, Turn 2: yellow, Turn 3: red, Turn 4: white).
    *   Wires: 1:[blue], 2:[green], 3:[yellow] (all intact).
    *   Mute sent nothing this turn or last turn.
    *   As Deaf: I cannot hear anything. I don't know what Blind is saying or feeling on the bomb. Blind can feel and operate things. Mute can hear Blind and read the manual. Mute can gesture to me.
    *   Why is Mute silent? Blind might have asked a question, but Mute hasn't responded, or Blind hasn't asked anything, or Mute is waiting for a specific light color or display number?
    *   Wait! What if the light sequence is important, or Mute is waiting for a specific color?
    *   I need to report the current light color (`white`), full history of light colors (`T1: blue, T2: yellow, T3: red, T4: white`), and reiterate the wires and display.
    *   Also remind Mute: "Mute, I cannot hear Blind. If Blind speaks to you, you must gesture instructions/answers to me so I can speak them back to Blind."

2.  **Drafting the message:**
    *   State: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [white].
    *   Light history: Turn 1 blue -> Turn 2 yellow -> Turn 3 red -> Turn 4 white.
    *   Wires: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow.
    *   Prompt: Remind Mute to gesture if any action is required or if responding to Blind.The bomb status on Turn 4 is:
- Display: 0
- Light: WHITE (Color history: Turn 1 blue -> Turn 2 yellow -> Turn 3 red -> Turn 4 white)
- Wires: Wire 1 is blue, Wire 2 is green, Wire 3 is yellow (all intact)

Mute sent no gestures this turn.

I need to report the light change to white, summarize the full sequence of colors seen, and remind Mute that since I cannot hear Blind's voice, any guidance or answers to Blind must be gestured to me to relay.

```
speak(text="Status update Turn 4: Light is now WHITE. (Light history: T1 blue, T2 yellow, T3 red, T4 white). Display remains 0. Wires remain: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. Mute, remember I cannot hear Blind; please gesture to me any instructions or answers to relay.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

Thinking:
The light has changed to GREEN.
History of flashing light:
Turn 1: blue
Turn 2: yellow
Turn 3: red
Turn 4: white
Turn 5: green

Display is still 0.
Wires are still intact: 1 is blue, 2 is green, 3 is yellow.
Still no gestures received from Mute. I need to announce the new light color and history, and prompt Mute to communicate using simple gestures.

```
speak(text="Turn 5: Light is now GREEN. History: blue -> yellow -> red -> white -> green. Display: 0. Wires: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. Mute, please gesture instructions if Blind needs to do something!")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[green] 3:[yellow]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

The light has cycled back to BLUE.
Display: 0.
Wires: 1:[blue], 2:[green], 3:[yellow].

Mute has just gestured: [☝] (number 1 / pointing up).
Following my previous prompt suggesting ☝ for wire 1 or option 1, Mute is almost certainly indicating 1 (likely cut wire 1, or whatever option 1 was discussed between Blind and Mute).

I will announce this clearly to Blind and Mute.

```
speak(text="Turn 6 update: Light is BLUE. Display: 0. Mute just gestured: [☝] (One). Blind, Mute is signalling number 1 (wire 1 or option 1). If you asked a question, the answer is 1.")
```
